# Educative

> > Interactive learning platform offering hands-on courses in coding interview preparation, system design, cloud computing (AWS), generative AI, and software development with technologies like Python, Java, LangChain, and Flutter.

Educative provides text-based, browser-based coding courses and interview prep resources including the popular Blind 75 LeetCode problems and Grokking the Coding Interview Patterns. The platform serves developers preparing for MAANG (Meta, Apple, Amazon, Netflix, Google) interviews and engineers learning cloud technologies, AI/ML, and modern programming languages.

## Key Topics

- Coding Interview Preparation
- Blind 75 LeetCode Problems
- Grokking the Coding Interview Patterns
- MAANG Interviews
- System Design
- AWS Cloud Computing
- Generative AI & LLMs
- Python Programming
- Java Development
- LangChain
- Flutter & Dart
- Web Development
- DevOps Training
- Developer Productivity Tools
- Cloud Certification

## Coding Interview Preparation

- [Blind 75 Questions with Solutions](https://www.educative.io/blind75): Curated Blind 75 LeetCode problems for coding interview preparation
- [Blind 75 vs LeetCode patterns: Which wins coding interviews?](https://www.educative.io/blog/blind-75-and-leetcode-patterns): Comparing Blind 75 questions vs LeetCode patterns for FAANG interviews
- [The counterfeit coin problem: A popular MAANG interview question](https://www.educative.io/blog/counterfeit-coin-problem): MAANG interview puzzle: solving counterfeit coin problem analytically
- [Top 10 .NET interview questions and answers](https://www.educative.io/blog/dotnet-interview-questions): Top 10 intermediate to advanced .NET and C# interview questions

## Generative AI & Machine Learning

- [Top 5 Best Generative AI Courses](https://www.educative.io/blog/best-generative-ai-courses): Top 5 generative AI courses for building LLM apps and AI agents
- [Mastering advanced prompt engineering: Part 1](https://www.educative.io/blog/advanced-prompt-engineering-pt-1): Chain-of-Thought and advanced LLM prompting techniques for AI reasoning
- [Bellman Equation in Reinforcement Learning](https://www.educative.io/blog/bellman-equation-in-reinforcement-learning): Bellman equation, MDPs, and shortest path algorithms in RL explained

## Developer Tools & Productivity

- [Top AI coding copilots: Why Codeium is the best choice?](https://www.educative.io/blog/ai-coding-copilots): Comparing Codeium, GitHub Copilot, Tabnine for AI-powered coding
- [Claude Code vs. Codex vs. Gemini Code Assist: 2026 dev review](https://www.educative.io/blog/claude-code-vs-codex-vs-gemini-code-assist): Comparing Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Gemini Code Assist for devs

## Cloud Computing & AWS

- [A quick AWS tutorial: The services you should definitely use](https://www.educative.io/blog/amazon-aws-best-services): Essential AWS services tutorial: EC2, Lambda, and cloud storage basics
- [Applied Data Science: serverless functions, pipelines and PySpark](https://www.educative.io/blog/applied-data-science-pyspark-serverless-functions): PySpark and AWS Lambda for scalable data science model pipelines

## Web Development & Programming Fundamentals

- [Angular for Beginners: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.educative.io/blog/angular-for-beginners): Complete Angular beginner tutorial with TypeScript and Angular CLI setup
- [The basics of responsive web design](https://www.educative.io/blog/basics-of-responsive-web-design): CSS media queries, viewport config, and mobile-first responsive design
- [Computer networking 101: Terms, tools, and getting started](https://www.educative.io/blog/computer-networking-101): Networking basics: Ethernet, LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, OSI model for beginners
- [Can I learn Dart as my first language?](https://www.educative.io/blog/can-i-learn-dart-as-my-first-language): Beginner guide comparing Dart to Python/Java for first-time programmers
